Klasse SemVer.SemVerBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.quurz.foomp.base.misc.SemVer.SemVerBuilder
Umschließende Klasse:
SemVer
public static final class SemVer.SemVerBuilder extends Object

Fluent builder for constructing SemVer instances with optional components.

All numeric components default to 0. Optional components (pre-release, build metadata) default to absent. All setter methods validate their inputs and return this for method chaining.

Example: 

  var version = SemVer.semVerBuilder()
      .major(2)
      .minor(1)
      .patch(0)
      .preRelease("beta.1")
      .buildMetadata("build.20241029")
      .build();  // "2.1.0-beta.1+build.20241029"
Seit:
1.0.0
